scope: Complete traffic-cap, traffic-ray and TrafficStep branch comparison; selected main-loop consumers. Not whole-HBQ parity.

findings.intent: Continuous following rather than binary stops
findings.source: TrafficCap follows the nearest limiting same-direction crewed vehicle above 3 km/h, using speed and mass/time gap; TrafficRays does not stop for a faster same-direction moving peer except hard occupancy.
findings.cbe: DrivingFollowingCap uses actual forward velocity, oriented hull occupancy, continuous gap correction and mass/reaction closing caps. ConvoyTick owns registered predecessor spacing and preserves independent traffic caps.
findings.remaining: Step-off, braking, mixed tracks/wheels and actual traffic throughput are unaccepted. A source formula cannot prove reduced stop/start.

findings.intent: Avoid false crossing and adjacent-lane holds
findings.source: Oncoming priority requires lane overlap; crossing response uses overlapping occupancy windows and yields to the right. Forward traffic rays are one centre ray; rear rays fan three.
findings.cbe: DrivingFollowingCap uses eight-corner hull bounds and measured crossing courses with occupancy windows; left-side emergency approach still brakes. DrivingGeometryCap handles curved body/support sampling separately.
findings.remaining: Conservative projected extents, curved crossings, sloped/stacked routes and large modded hulls require physical comparison. Do not copy source centre-only sensing as a safety guarantee.

findings.intent: Finite room-making when queues cannot progress
findings.source: TrafficStep maintains yield/pass pairs and backing requests; standing crossing-angle jams can also enter pair handling. It invokes physics push and timed traffic-ignore windows.
findings.cbe: Distinct authenticated queue roster/roles/expiry consent exists; no HOLD/READY/reverse/dependency executor. Existing pass consent and ordinary route retries do not implement queue recovery.
findings.remaining: Native room-making, stationary crossing-angle topology and dependency progress remain missing. Reverse capability must be demonstrated; physics pushes and unconditional ignore windows are rejected.

findings.intent: Separate observation cadence from cap retention
findings.source: Main loop keeps prior obstacle/traffic caps between independent due times; nearby crewed traffic changes alert/cadence.
findings.cbe: Existing shared owner callback samples traffic at one second while constrained and four seconds otherwise; four-second nominal reaction is retained in the closing envelope. Convoys tick once per second.
findings.remaining: No live latency or performance result; proximity-driven faster sampling needs a bounded cost comparison, not blanket cadence acceleration.

findings.intent: Followers must not repair the leader route
findings.source: Leader-vehicle followers are excluded from shared-waypoint restore/replan; otherwise trailing vehicles restore already-completed leader waypoints repeatedly.
findings.cbe: DrivingAssistStart already gates route recovery to the current leader vehicle; convoy followers use predecessor trails.
findings.remaining: Leader changes, individual orders and physical formation/path handback require live acceptance.

findings.intent: Current crew task authority at startup and missing-trail holds
findings.source: The source loop checks current driver activity but is not a substitute for CBE two-seat/reservation ownership.
findings.cbe: Found four convoy stop sites using an earlier group-only or unguarded check. Startup steering/native holds and missing-trail steering/native holds now check actual seats inside the stop/receipt transaction. Refusal creates no hold/path-owner receipt.
findings.remaining: No guarantee of physical stopping or complete convoy authority: lead resume, group formation and other setup writers remain separate review items.

validation.source: 9fc38cd9 plus intended convoy hold source, guide and two regression contracts; review/handover metadata follows build
